name: Hearty Chicken Pot Pie
description: A comforting chicken pot pie filled with vegetables and chicken in a creamy sauce, topped with a pie crust.
recipeIngredient: 1 cup mixed vegetables (corn, carrots, leeks, mushrooms)
1 cup red wine or soya sauce

recipeInstructions.text: In a saucepan, simmer the mixed vegetables in chicken stock for 5 minutes.
In another saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Whisk in milk and red wine (or soya sauce). Bring to a boil and thicken.
Add cooked chicken, tarragon, lemon rind, salt, and pepper to the sauce. Mix well.
Pour the filling into unbaked pie shells.
Cover with top crust and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot. Note that the filling freezes well for later use.

keywords: chicken pot pie, comfort food, savory pie

_similar.name: Turkey or Chicken Pies
_similar.description: Individual or large pies filled with turkey or chicken, vegetables, and a creamy sauce, topped with a homemade pastry crust or biscuits.
_similar.recipeYield: Multiple individual pies or 1 large pie

recipeInstructions.text: Melt margarine with salt and pepper over low heat. Add flour and gradually add broth, cooking until smooth.
Sauté chopped onion and celery until tender.
Boil carrots until thoroughly cooked.
Mix cooked carrots with peas and the sauce made earlier.
For the pastry, mix flour, salt, and baking powder with butter. Add milk to form a dough.
Fill small pans or a large pie plate with the turkey or chicken mixture and top with pastry crust or biscuits.
Bake until the crust is golden brown.

_similar.keywords: turkey pie, chicken pie, savory pastry, comfort food

_similar.name: Chicken and Cheese Casserole
_similar.description: A comforting chicken and rice casserole topped with a crunchy corn flake and celery mixture.
recipeIngredient: 1 can Campbell's cream of celery soup

recipeInstructions.text: Blend together the chicken, rice, cream soup, milk, cheese, and onion in a large bowl.
Put the mixture into a buttered casserole dish.
Stir the corn flake crumbs into melted butter, then mix in the chopped celery.
Cook until the celery is hot.
Spread the corn flake and celery mixture over the chicken mixture.
Bake in a 375°F oven for about ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: chicken casserole, cheesy rice bake, comfort food

_similar.name: Ken Noodle Supper
_similar.description: A hearty chicken and noodle supper with a creamy sauce, mixed vegetables, and a blend of herbs.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (10 oz/300 g) frozen mixed vegetables

recipeInstructions.text: Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes. Cook in butter in a large skillet over medium heat for 5 minutes.
Add onion, mushrooms, and garlic. Cook until onion is tender.
Stir in flour, salt, pepper, and herbs. Cook until thickens.
Gradually add milk, stirring constantly. Bring to a boil and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add mustard and noodles. Return to a boil.
Add frozen vegetables. Stir and cook for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: chicken noodle supper, creamy sauce, comfort food

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Tomato Macaroni Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and comforting soup featuring macaroni, vegetables, and a rich tomato broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute onion, celery, and carrot in oil until tender.
Add stock, juice, and water. Bring to a boil.
Add pasta and cook until tender.
Add garlic salt and Worcestershire sauce.
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
